commands.detail: 4 tests: adapter delegation, false propagation, separator normalization to E.164, malformed-number rejection.

7 tests against the real HTTP server, PostgreSQL and Redis: exact pinned document true/false, separator normalization, BAD_USER_INPUT for five malformed shapes, public-access 403 without the handshake, RATE_LIMITED cap, unique-index enforcement, and no writes on lookup.
Populated migration-005 upgrade preserves every baseline row with the phone column empty, and the fresh-database deploy applies the complete history.

evidenceStatus.reason: The apps list includes web, app and rider, so the evidence checker requires web (playwright/webJourney, W16) and device (W19) evidence. Both harnesses are unbuilt, so this record stays NOT_VERIFIED.

knownLimits: Phone shape policy is recorded rather than assumed: `+` plus 7-15 digits with no leading zero, client separators removed first. The pinned apps send toE164(phone, countryCode), which this accepts; an owner-specified country policy would be a configuration change, not an invented rule.
Existence is status-independent, matching emailExist: a suspended account keeps its unique number.
The contract answers an existence question about another principal, so it is rate-limited per caller and per number and returns nothing else.
